param.name: enablebuying
param.comment: Buy wares the station wants and deliver them home.

param.name: enableselling
param.comment: Sell the station's surplus wares to the best accessible buyer.

param.name: wareprio
param.comment: Wares to manage, top to bottom priority. Leave empty to auto-manage everything the station wants.

param.name: balanced
param.comment: Spread purchases evenly across wares instead of strict priority.

param.name: fillcargo
param.comment: Fill the cargo hold across all wanted wares before returning home to deliver.

param.name: manageconstruction
param.comment: Also resupply Build Storage (construction wares) for stations under construction/expansion.

param.name: buildstoragefirst
param.comment: Service Build Storage before production wares when both need supplies this pass.

param.name: usepercentcap
param.comment: Use percent-below-home-sell-price cap instead of a flat max price.

param.name: maxprice
param.comment: Flat max price per unit, used when Price Cap Mode is off.

param.name: minpercent
param.comment: Skip deals discounted by less than this percent, used when Price Cap Mode is on.

param.name: scanspeed
param.comment: How many offer checks run before yielding a tick.

param.name: enablelogbook
param.comment: Write a logbook entry for every delivery.

param.name: debugtrace
param.comment: Write troubleshooting details to a log file (Documents/Egosoft/X4/.../StationTrader/).
